title: Gaia Skill Batch Intake
description: Reviewable batch of known and proposed skills detected by gaia push.

fromFile.description: True when the batch was produced by `gaia push --from-file` (legacy YAML) or the RFC2-B discovery-packet adapter (intakeAdapter.py). File-sourced batches are not similarity-scored against the scan, so `similarity` is NOT required when fromFile is true (the conditional at the schema root).

curationHandoff.description: Immutable packet provenance copied into the batch by the explicit post-L4 adapter handoff.

candidateId.description: Full pre-slug candidate identity from the discovery packet (may be `contributor/slug`); preserved verbatim for provenance while `id` carries the kebab-safe form. Emitted by intakeAdapter.py.

type.description: Yggdrasil II skill taxonomy: basic (0 prerequisites) or fusion (≥1 prerequisite). Must stay identical to skill.schema.json properties.type — the intake layer may not admit a type the canonical schema rejects. The legacy values extra/unique/ultimate are retired as types; Extra/Ultimate/Apex survive only as RANK WORDS, and Suite/Unique are read-time-derived branches.

prerequisites.description: Prerequisite skill ids (Yggdrasil II Axis B). Empty for basic; ≥1 for fusion. Emitted by both the legacy --from-file producer and intakeAdapter.py.

attribution.description: Provenance reference for the upstream source, NOT a strength claim. Emitted by the legacy --from-file producer (upstream_author + skill_file_url + type) and by intakeAdapter.py (skill_file_url + type).

named.description: Optional named-implementation block from intake. contributor + links_github are required by pushFromFile when present. level defaults to 2★ floor (non-authoritative at intake; TM scoring derives higher ranks).

skill_name.description: Optional upstream SKILL.md folder/name (e.g. 'seo' for Bhanunamikaze/seo). If omitted, defaults to generic skill id.

mapsToGeneric.description: The existing generic skill id this candidate maps to (Axis A satisfied). Emitted by intakeAdapter.py for MAP-decision packets.

suite.description: Suite fan-out reference reconstructed from the discovery packet. Emitted by intakeAdapter.py.

attributionScope.description: Derived from the suite role by intakeAdapter.attributionScopeForRole: capstone→suite-wide, component→suite-component, else standalone. Governs whether the source proof may be copied full-strength across components downstream.
